name: jp-verify-mcp

tools.name: verify_japanese_company
tools.description: Check a Japanese business in JP-Verify by its qualified-invoice registration number (T + 13 digits) or its 13-digit Corporate Number (法人番号). Returns the invoice-registration status (registered, expired, revoked or not_registered) with its dates, the Corporate Number, and for companies the Japanese name and address with an English rendering (name_en_source 'official-en' = filed by the company; 'generated' = machine romanisation, not authoritative). Sole proprietors: number, status and dates only. Source: the National Tax Agency's published data as served by JP-Verify; JP-Verify's attribution and data_as_of fields are kept as sent. Not tax advice. One metered lookup; a malformed or mistyped number is rejected without a call.

number.description: A T-number such as T1180301018771, or a 13-digit Corporate Number. Spaces, hyphens and full-width characters are accepted.
number.title: Number

tools.name: verify_japanese_companies_batch
tools.description: The same check as verify_japanese_company for many numbers in one call: up to 100 per call on the key-less sandbox and Starter keys, 500 on Growth, 1,000 on Reseller. Malformed or mistyped numbers come back under `invalid` and are not charged; each well-formed number is one metered lookup. Large batches give large outputs. Source: the National Tax Agency's published data as served by JP-Verify (attribution kept). Not tax advice.

tools.name: get_major_shareholders
tools.description: Major shareholders (「大株主の状況」, about the ten largest holders) that a Japanese company published in its annual or semi-annual securities report on EDINET, from JP-Verify, by Corporate Number. Holders are named only when they are organisations; other holders are reported without names, normally as an aggregate (count and combined ratio). A company that files no such report gets status no_public_disclosure: a statement of why nothing is published, not a claim that it has no shareholders. Facts as filed at the filing's basis date; not an ownership or control determination. One metered lookup. If JP-Verify has not enabled this route yet, the tool says so.

corporate_number.description: The company's 13-digit Corporate Number (法人番号); a T-number is also accepted.
corporate_number.title: Corporate Number

as_of.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: use the latest filing submitted on or before this date. The holdings are as of that filing's own basis date.
as_of.title: As Of

annotations.title: Major shareholders of a Japanese company

tools.name: find_japanese_company_by_name
tools.description: Find candidate Corporate Numbers (法人番号) for a Japanese company name (kanji, kana, romaji or the company's registered English name) with JP-Verify's deterministic matching (rule-based exact keys, not fuzzy search). Candidates carry prefecture and city to tell same-name companies apart; a name match is not proof of identity, so confirm the candidate, then call verify_japanese_company. Corporations only. One metered lookup; an empty candidate list is a valid answer.

name.description: A company name, e.g. トヨタ自動車株式会社 or Toyota Jidosha.
name.title: Name

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates: 1-25 on the key-less sandbox and Starter keys, up to 100 on Growth and Reseller keys.
limit.title: Limit

annotations.title: Find a Japanese company by name

instructions: JP-Verify answers questions about Japanese companies from Japan's public registers, in English. Use verify_japanese_company for one T-number or Corporate Number, verify_japanese_companies_batch for a list, find_japanese_company_by_name when you only have a name (then verify the number you pick), and get_major_shareholders for the major-shareholder table of a company that files securities reports on EDINET. Every call is one metered lookup; without an API key JP-Verify's key-less sandbox answers, limited per IP address per day. Answers are register facts as of the dates they state, not tax, legal or ownership advice. Keep the attribution fields when you republish the data.
